core_claim.quote: That recurrent processing is necessary for visual awareness is now fairly well established, and supported by numerous experiments

source.citation: Lamme VAF. How neuroscience will change our view on consciousness. Cognitive Neuroscience 1(3):204-220, 2010 (discussion paper; commentaries and response follow on pp. 220-240)

prediction.statement: Disrupting the signals that higher visual areas send back to early visual cortex (with a magnetic pulse at the right moment, with masking, or with anaesthesia) takes away seeing, while the first forward signals are left largely intact.
